title: Automatic Driving Exam Disqualification: Striking Curb/Cone, Rolling Stop, or Examiner Intervention

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Only single blue SUV visible per panel; no opposing vehicles facing each other in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Right panel shows left-hand drive: driver on left seat holding wheel, examiner/passenger on right reaching over; no right-side steering wheel.

single_bulb_signal.note: Middle panel traffic light shows two lit lenses simultaneously: red top lit and green bottom lit.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Middle panel shows yellow centerline on left of lane and white edge/curb on right; right panel forward view shows double-yellow center left of travel and white edge on right.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words on signs, plates, or road; stop sign and plate are blank shapes, red-circle white-X marks are graphic icons as prompted.

scene_match.note: Three panels match prompt: left tire crushing knocked-over orange cone, middle car past white stop bar, right examiner hand grabbing wheel from passenger seat.

result.summary: Three disqualification scenes are correctly depicted, but traffic signal illegally shows red and green lit together, failing single-bulb rule.

teaching_correct.note: Three automatic-failure concepts are illustrated correctly with red-X warnings; signal error does not invert the main lesson.

result.what_i_see: Three side-by-side red-bordered panels with red-X icons: left close-up of blue SUV tire over a knocked-down orange cone, middle rear view of blue SUV beyond a white stop bar beside a blank stop sign and traffic light, right interior view of female driver with male passenger reaching to grab the steering wheel.
